_about: Narration for the Spend Radar demo film (v2). `say` is what the voice reads (spelled for pronunciation); `cap` is the on-screen caption. `exag` sets the voice's expressiveness for that line (0.5 calm .. 0.75 lively). Every number comes from the evidence named in `src`. Scene visuals live in film/src/scenes; their length follows the narration.

lines.say: Your competitor just doubled their M L team.
lines.cap: Your competitor just doubled their ML team.

lines.say: And you'll find out... next quarter.
lines.cap: And you'll find out… next quarter.

lines.say: Unless your agent finds out first.
lines.cap: Unless your agent finds out first.

lines.say: This is Spend Radar. It reads your finance files, checks the market with real data, and then tries to prove itself wrong.
lines.cap: This is Spend Radar. It reads your finance files, checks the market with real data — then tries to prove itself wrong.

lines.say: It plans the job, then reads the budget, the invoices, and the policy.
lines.cap: It plans the job, then reads the budget, the invoices and the policy.

lines.say: It pulls real competitor headcount from Crust data.
lines.cap: It pulls real competitor headcount from Crustdata.

lines.say: And Python does every calculation, so each number carries its source.
lines.cap: Python does every calculation, so each number carries its source.

lines.say: Things break. A scanned P D F. A rate limit. Totals that don't add up.
lines.cap: Things break. A scanned PDF. A rate limit. Totals that don't add up.

lines.say: So it picks a recovery, and in a hundred and eighty-three of three hundred and seventy-two decisions, it overrode the default.
lines.cap: It picks a recovery — and in 183 of 372 decisions, it overrode the default.

lines.say: Now, our favourite part.
lines.cap: Now, our favourite part.

lines.say: It flagged a gap of up to five point two eight million dollars in Acme's M L team.
lines.cap: It flagged a gap of up to $5.28M in Acme's ML team.

lines.say: Then it argued with itself, and overturned its own claim.
lines.cap: Then it argued with itself — and overturned its own claim.

lines.say: Wrong claims never reach the report.
lines.cap: Wrong claims never reach the report.

lines.say: Seven companies. Six it had never seen.
lines.cap: 7 companies. 6 it had never seen.

lines.say: Every planted error, caught. Zero false alarms.
lines.cap: Every planted error caught. Zero false alarms.

lines.say: Even with Crust data and the model rate-limited on purpose.
lines.cap: Even with Crustdata and the LLM rate-limited on purpose.
lines.src: summary.injected_runs: faults crustdata:429 + llm:429, all planted errors caught

lines.say: Every call, every retry, every decision, traced in neat logs.
lines.cap: Every call, every retry, every decision — traced in neatlogs.

lines.say: One trace showed it throwing away three of five competitors. The fix kept all five, and cut credits from twenty-six point six to five point four.
lines.cap: One trace: 3 of 5 competitors thrown away. The fix: all 5 kept, credits 26.6 → 5.4.

lines.say: Another showed the same data getting three different verdicts. Now, it's one. Every time.
lines.cap: Same data, 3 different verdicts. Now: 1. Every time.

lines.say: Entire gave our coding agent a memory. More than sixty checkpoints, each tying a commit to the prompt that wrote it.
lines.cap: Entire gave our coding agent a memory: 60+ checkpoints, each tying a commit to the prompt that wrote it.
lines.src: git ls-remote origin refs/entire/checkpoints/*: 67 refs, 11 Oct

lines.say: Click any neat logs span, and explain walks back to the line of code, the commit, and the exact prompt behind it.
lines.cap: Click any neatlogs span → the code line → the commit → the exact prompt behind it.

lines.say: And Entire's review runner caught a real bug in our audit, before we merged it.
lines.cap: Entire's review runner caught a real bug in our audit — before we merged it.
lines.src: hackathon.md 2026-10-11 13:30 entry; trail #2 finding 01M4N4SF2YQX fixed in a16758f

lines.say: And C F O dot A I turned our measured costs into a real plan.
lines.cap: And cfo.ai turned our measured costs into a real plan.

lines.say: Under three cents of A I per run. Competitor data is ninety-nine percent of the cost.
lines.cap: Under 3¢ of AI per run. Competitor data: ~99% of the cost.

lines.say: Base case: cash-flow positive by January twenty twenty-eight. Next move: test the Team plan at four ninety-five.
lines.cap: Base case: cash-flow positive Jan 2028. Next: test Team at $495.

lines.say: Spend Radar. Every number has a source.
lines.cap: Spend Radar. Every number has a source.
